title: erodium immaculatum
intro: Erodium immaculatum, commonly known as the White Heron's Bill, is a flowering plant species within the Geranium family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in treating various ailments such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Erodium immaculatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and exhibit antibacterial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
